overview_description.description: Dods Is a favor hub allowing people to exchange favors, let it be anything! if you're asking for a book! Need a pick up! Need someone to help you with studying! Dods is your place to go. NOT just that! you can also post what you can help with and take a favor in return, because whenever you do someone a favor, you get a favor back in return from Dods App
